name: code_assignment
description: GH #3588 / REQ-648. One row of the assignment history: the code (code_id, a real foreign key onto code_tag) named the record target_type / target_id from assigned_at until released_at (empty while open). target_type and target_id are declarative (decision 0050 D3.6): no key is possible and the target is not validated here. A row changes only once, when it is closed.
